---
title: "Transforms"
---

Scale transformation utilities ported from
[CytoPipeline](https://uclouvain-cbio.github.io/CytoPipeline/) (UCLouvain-CBIO).

## `sw_transform_estimate` {#sw_transform_estimate}

Estimate scale transformations.

### Usage

```r
sw_transform_estimate(
  ff,
  fluo_method = c("estimateLogicle", "none"),
  scatter_method = c("none", "linearQuantile"),
  scatter_ref_marker = NULL,
  specific_scatter_channels = NULL,
  verbose = FALSE,
  ...
)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `ff` | A `flowFrame`. |
| `fluo_method` | Transformation method for fluorochrome channels: `"estimateLogicle"` (default) or `"none"`. |
| `scatter_method` | Transformation method for scatter channels: `"none"` (default) or `"linearQuantile"`. |
| `scatter_ref_marker` | Optional reference marker name for scatter scaling. |
| `specific_scatter_channels` | Optional character vector of scatter channel names to transform. |
| `verbose` | Logical; print progress messages. |
| `...` | Additional arguments passed to `flowCore::estimateLogicle()`. |

### Details

Estimates per-channel scale transformations to obtain well-separated positive
and negative populations. Fluorochrome channels can be transformed with
logicle (via `flowCore::estimateLogicle()`), while scatter channels can be
linearly scaled to match the dynamic range of a reference fluorochrome channel.

### Value

A `flowCore::transformList` object.

---

## `sw_transform_apply` {#sw_transform_apply}

Apply scale transformations.

### Usage

```r
sw_transform_apply(x, trans_list)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `x` | A `flowFrame` or `flowSet`. |
| `trans_list` | A `flowCore::transformList` (from `sw_transform_estimate()`). |

### Details

Applies a pre-computed `flowCore::transformList` to a `flowFrame` or
`flowSet`.

### Value

The transformed `flowFrame` or `flowSet`.
